source.attribution: Combination of the member sources listed on each run; their attributions and licences apply. NOAA/NCEP Global Forecast System (GFS) and GFS-Wave (WAVEWATCH III), via the NOAA Open Data Dissemination (NODD) program. Contains modified ECMWF open data: Copyright European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF), IFS HRES and ecWAM real-time forecasts, licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Modified by Swell Travel Agent: sampled to the nearest grid cell of each spot and converted to other units (wind m/s to km/h, pressure Pa to hPa); derived values such as hs_ge_12s_m are ours, not ECMWF's.
